issues.title: Coupon not applying at checkout
issues.problem_statement: The customer's coupon code was not applying at checkout for their Advanced Course and showed "Invalid coupon".

issues.title: Wrong company name on invoice
issues.problem_statement: The company name in the GST part of the customer's invoice was wrong.

issues.title: Coupon expiry date extension
issues.problem_statement: The customer wanted to extend the expiry date of their coupon.

items.description: Support explained that the coupon was assigned only to the Starter Course and not to the Advanced Course, so the Advanced Course needed to be assigned to it.
evidence: Coupon dashboard mein ye coupon sirf Starter Course ke liye assign hai, Advanced Course ke liye nahi.

items.description: Customer edited the coupon, selected the Advanced Course in the Products section and saved it, following support's guidance, and confirmed the discount now shows at checkout.
evidence: Coupon ko edit karo, Products section mein Advanced Course select karo aur save kar do.
Ho gaya. Ab test karta hoon... haan, ab checkout pe discount dikh raha hai.

items.description: Customer reported that the company name in the GST part of the invoice is wrong.
evidence: invoice mein meri company ka naam galat aa raha hai, GST wale part mein.

items.description: Support will check with the billing team about the company name on the invoice and let the customer know by tomorrow.
evidence: Uske liye main billing team se check karke aapko kal tak bata dunga.

items.description: Support explained that the customer can extend the coupon's expiry date themselves in the coupon settings, where the date option is available.
evidence: Expiry aap khud coupon settings mein badha sakte ho, wahin date ka option milega.

items.description: Customer will extend the coupon's expiry date tonight.
evidence: Haan, main aaj raat badha dunga.

skip_recommendation.explanation: Complete support call with clear outcomes.
